summary: Authors may use generative AI tools but must describe the use transparently and in detail in the Methods or Acknowledgements, and also explain it in the cover letter. AI tools cannot be listed as authors, and authors remain fully responsible for accuracy. Tools used only for spelling, grammar and general editing fall outside the scope of the AI guidelines, though the cover letter asks about tools such as Grammarly.
